title: limpet profile file
description: Authoritative per-profile file (~/.config/limpet/profiles/{shortId}.profile.json). Hand-editing this file and saving live-applies through limpet's reconcile path. Dropping a NEW file with an unknown, well-formed `id` CREATES that profile (persisted always; the launchd agent installs only when the new profile is `isEnabled` and has all required fields filled in) — creation-via-file is supported, not just editing an existing profile. Keep this file's `properties` in lockstep with SyncProfile.CodingKeys (limpet/Models/SyncProfile.swift) — verified by scripts/check-schema-in-sync.sh.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file. Written automatically; safe to ignore.

id.description: Stable profile identifier. Do not change — a changed id is treated as a different profile.

name.description: Display name shown in the limpet UI.

localSyncPath.description: Local folder path synced with the remote.

drivePathToMonitor.description: External drive mount point to monitor (empty if not on an external drive).

additionalRcloneFlags.description: Extra flags appended to the rclone command. Whitespace-separated (split on IFS, not shell-parsed); a flag's value cannot contain a space.

isEnabled.description: Whether the scheduled sync agent is installed. Toggling this installs or uninstalls the launchd agent.

isMuted.description: Whether file-change notifications are muted for this profile.

transfers.description: rclone --transfers for this profile's sync (--checkers is 2x this value). Default 16.
